svg.title: One recording. Two frequency bands.
svg.desc: Actual public wind-tunnel recording and ordered 56-microphone geometry. Excluding channels 1 and 7 leaves 54. Conventional beamforming maps nominal 4 kHz and 5 kHz third-octave bands on a supplied z=-0.68 m plane. Maxima are (-0.25,-0.1) m and (-0.25,0.05) m. Each map has its own peak-relative dB reference. No independently measured localization accuracy or absolute SPL.
